title: Rosemary and Honey Almond Tart
changes_from_base: A rosemary-infused honey and flaked almond custard, rather than frangipane and poached pears.
summary: A lemony pastry case filled with a rich honey custard and flaked almonds, scented with rosemary.
equipment: 25 cm fluted tart tin, 2-2.5 cm deep

ingredients.item: plain flour, plus extra for rolling
fine sea salt or table salt
cold unsalted butter, in 1 cm cubes, plus extra for the tin
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Pastry
steps.text: butter the tin well. Mix the flour, sugar, zest and salt, rub in the butter to small pebbles, then add the yolks and water and bring together in clumps. Flatten into a disc, wrap and chill at least 30 min.

steps.title: Honey syrup
steps.text: warm the honey, rosemary, sugar, butter and salt in the pan over medium-low heat, stirring, for 6-8 min, until melted and smooth. Leave to cool 10 min. Gentle heat keeps the honey from boiling over.

steps.title: Custard
steps.text: whisk the egg, yolks and cream in the jug. Lift out the rosemary, whisk the egg mix into the honey and stir in the almonds.

steps.title: Line
steps.text: roll the pastry to a 30 cm round, ease it into the tin without stretching, and trim 5 mm above the rim. Chill 20 min while the oven heats to 190 °C (170 °C fan).

steps.title: Blind bake
steps.text: line with paper and beans and bake about 18 min. Remove them and bake 5 min more, pressing down any bubbles. Cool, then turn the oven to 180 °C (160 °C fan).

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: set the tin on the tray, pour in the filling and bake 30-35 min, until deep golden and set with a slow wobble. Cool completely before slicing. A slow wobble means the custard is just set.

tips: A mild floral honey lets the rosemary come through.
The filling can be made up to a week ahead and chilled.
Cover the rim with foil if it browns before the filling sets.
Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Keep in the fridge for up to 3 days, or freeze for up to 1 month.
